Polish-pass Option 2: Goalkeeper specialization.

User feedback (polish-pass review): "Goalkeepers running through all other players with the ball." Option-1 (player collision) shipped at ca96e3a. Option-2 fixes GK-runs-upfield-with-ball.

Context: BehaviorTreeRunner.Tick treats roster slot 1 (GK) identically to outfield 2-11. Build-up mode → carrier (incl. GK) heads to opponent goal. Press mode → nearest player (incl. GK) sprints to ball. Neither matches football GK behaviour.

acceptance:
- BehaviorTreeRunner.Tick branches on slot.RosterSlot == 1 BEFORE press/build-up/hold-shape branches. GK gets own decision tree.
- GK-in-possession: emit long-ball KickIntent toward forward-most eligible teammate (or opponent goal fallback). Move command = basePosition (hold formation slot). Never sprint upfield.
- GK-without-possession + ball in own penalty area (|ball.X - ownGoalLine| <= 16.5m): GK heads to ball at MaxSpeed.
- GK-without-possession + ball outside own penalty area: GK heads to basePosition at half speed.
- Determinism: Q32.32 throughout, sqrt-free where possible.
- 60-tick smoke hash MAY drift (probably won't — GK rarely nearest in first 60 ticks at formation positions); 600-tick pass-the-ball + 60-tick primed WILL drift (authorized; retain history in test-file comments).
- New file MatchSim.Tests/Sim/GoalkeeperBehaviorTests.cs (~150 LoC, 5 facts): InPossession_DoesNotHeadToOpponentGoal; InPossession_EmitsLongBallKick; WithoutPossession_BallOutsidePenaltyArea_HoldsFormation; WithoutPossession_BallInsidePenaltyArea_ChargesAtBall; Deterministic_AcrossManyRuns.
- All 7 PlayerSeparation tests still pass.
- fw verify GREEN; tests pass.
- Natural-play L2: DotsViewer.unity + usePrimedFixture=true. ≥30s natural play. Screenshot showing away GK ON the goal-line (not sprinting upfield). Save docs/screenshots/c5-option2-gk-specialization-natural-tick-NNNN.png.

commit-proposal: Option-2 goalkeeper specialization

## Summary
BehaviorTreeRunner.Tick now branches on `slot.RosterSlot == 1` BEFORE the press/build-up/hold-shape branches. GK gets three deterministic behaviours:
1. In possession (own team + GK is nearest-to-ball): emit long-ball KickIntent via existing ChoosePassKick, but move-target = basePosition (NEVER sprint upfield).
2. Without possession + ball inside own penalty area (|ball.X - ownGoalLine| <= 16.5m): charge at ball at MaxSpeed.
3. Otherwise: hold formation at half speed.

New constants `PenaltyAreaDepthMetres` (16.5m FIFA spec) + `GoalkeeperRosterSlot=1` (hardcoded for Month-3; Phase-4 role-system will replace).

## Files
- MatchSim/Sim/BehaviorTreeRunner.cs (+58 LoC: 2 constants + GK branch + ownGoalLine helper inside Tick)
- MatchSim.Tests/Sim/GoalkeeperBehaviorTests.cs (new, 5 facts, ~200 LoC)
- MatchSim.Tests/Sim/PassTheBallTests.cs (re-pin 600-tick hash + history comment)
- MatchSim.Tests/Sim/LowCutbackPrimedFixtureTests.cs (re-pin 60-tick primed hash + history)
- MatchSim.Tests/fixtures/replay-corpus/0xfeedbeefcafefade.json (re-pin final_canonical_state_hash)

## Natural-play L2 observation
DotsViewer.unity, driveSim=True, usePrimedFixture=True, seed 0xfeedbeefcafefade. Played ~35s wall-clock to frame 128542+ with ZERO synthetic injection.

Probed at frame 128542 (snapshot via Unity_RunCommand, position dump):
- Home GK at (-45.39, 0.09) — IN formation slot (base = -45, 0); 7.62m from goal-line.
- Away GK at (47.70, 0.48) — ON goal-line (X within 5m of +52.5); 4.77m from goal-line.
- Both GKs inside their penalty areas (within 16.5m of goal-line).
- Home back-four spread (-25 to -30 on X, ±20 on Z) ✓
- Home midfield 4 around X=-15 ✓
- Home strikers pulled back to mid-pitch (X≈6 — press position, ball at midfield with away possession)
- Away_6 carrier at (5.29, -0.23), ball at (7.11, -0.23) — outfield possession at midfield
- NEITHER GK has run upfield with the ball. NEITHER GK is at midfield. Both held position.

L2 screenshots: c5-option2-gk-specialization-natural-frame{66k,105k}.png.

## Acceptance
- [x] GK branch fires BEFORE press/build-up/hold-shape on slot.RosterSlot==1
- [x] GK in possession: doesn't head to opponent goal (test_DoesNotHeadToOpponentGoal)
- [x] GK in possession: emits long-ball kick (test_EmitsLongBallKick)
- [x] GK without possession + ball outside box: holds formation (test_BallOutsidePenaltyArea_HoldsFormation)
- [x] GK without possession + ball inside box: charges at MaxSpeed (test_BallInsidePenaltyArea_ChargesAtBall)
- [x] Deterministic (100-iter byte-identical GK command)
- [x] All 7 PlayerSeparation tests still pass (Option-1 untouched)
- [x] Authorized hash drift (600-tick + 60-tick primed) re-pinned with history; smoke UNCHANGED
- [x] fw verify GREEN; 663/663 tests pass
- [x] L2 captured — both GKs visibly on/near goal-lines

Awaiting reviewer ack.

ACK: I found no blocking issues in the Option-2 goalkeeper specialization proposal. The GK branch is ordered before the generic press/build-up/hold-shape branches, keeps the in-possession GK anchored to base position while preserving kick emission, and gates defensive charging to the own-box case. The new tests cover the requested GK cases, the primed corpus hash was updated with the matching replay fixture, and there is no out-of-scope source drift in `git status` beyond agent-bus dialog files.

Verification run locally: `scripts/fw verify` green with 663/663 tests, `scripts/fw replay 0xfeedbeefcafefade --compare-corpus` exit 0, `scripts/fw replay 0xdeadbeefdeadbeef --compare-corpus` exit 0, and `git diff --check` clean.
